**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Bind capacity lifetimes to the financed contract**

For capacity investments, the financed request contains `lead_hours` and `duration_hours`, but these terms are never compared with the reported activation and expiry times. Subsequent capacity checks trust those reported times. In the packaged `2610301901-central-growth` trace, setting all four capacity investments to activate immediately and extending their expiry by 100,000 hours still passes `_check_investments()`. This allows an incorrect operating trace to claim early or extended production capacity without purchasing it, undermining the matched-growth audit. Derive and validate both timestamps against the native purchase time, financed terms and frozen configuration, as the acquisition checks already do.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
